unit_note: USD millions. Department-level outlay lines from Table 3; each is standalone because this unit does not re-declare the full outlay roll-up (the sibling remainder unit holds the totals, and the department detail itself is Table 5's). Row COUNT is the check that matters here: strict coverage cannot see a missing standalone row. HUD FYTD prints 61,687 with footnote 1 ("Amount increased by $14 million due to additional reporting for the month of July 2026."); State FYTD prints 24,892 with footnote 2 ("Amount decreased by $36 million due to additional reporting for the month of July 2026."). The text layer glues those markers as 161,687 and 224,892; both resolved against the page-8 render.
